name: AlpacaEval
description: AlpacaEval is an automatic evaluation benchmark for instruction-following LLMs using LLM-based win rate comparison against a reference model. Given 805 instructions from diverse datasets, model outputs are compared pairwise against a reference model (originally text-davinci-003) by an LLM judge. Win rate measures instruction-following quality.
typical_sota_score: ~50-70% win rate (GPT-4 class models; varies by version)
reputation: Widely used LLM evaluation framework; strong correlation with ChatBot Arena human preferences; AlpacaEval 2.0 with length-controlled win rates is a standard benchmark
notes: Original version (2023) uses text-davinci-003 as reference. AlpacaEval 2.0 uses GPT-4 Turbo as judge with length-controlled win rate metric to reduce verbosity bias. Note: alpacaeval2.json and alpacaeval_2_0.json already exist in the benchmark list. This entry covers the original AlpacaEval v1 framing. Widely used across model evaluations.
